name: satisfactory-control-center
description: Read-only companion dashboard for inspecting the live state of a Satisfactory game.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @scc/shared && npm run build --workspace @scc/server && npm run build --workspace @scc/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @scc/server & npm run dev --workspace @scc/web
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
